text:
olivia: incident-bot flagged a weird routing loop across regions — probes flip between us-east -> us-west -> eu, traffic keeps bouncing, customers seeing 5xxs. paging oncall. :rotating_light:
oncall-bot: paging sam-sre (primary) and raj (backup) :pager:
incident-bot: alert rule smart-routing.health-flap triggered (threshold 3 flips / 2m) — affected clusters: us-east, us-west, eu.

sam-sre: on it, joining. can someone drop the latest probe traces and a short summary of affected traffic?

olivia: quick dump from the router logs — looks like healthcheck responses toggling, and fallback policy is routing to different model variants during the hops. snippet:
```
2026-03-15T12:04:02Z us-east probe -> UNHEALTHY (latency spike, 504)
2026-03-15T12:04:02Z router: fallback to us-west (policy: regional_fallback) -> routed requests use model variant v1-quant
2026-03-15T12:04:05Z us-west probe -> UNHEALTHY (kv-cache-miss surge)
2026-03-15T12:04:07Z router: fallback to eu -> routed requests use model variant v2-fp16
2026-03-15T12:04:10Z eu probe -> HEALTHY -> router re-routes back to us-east -> variant swap back to v1-quant
```

leo: that pattern (different variants per region) is the root cause — client sessions see model variant drift mid-session -> some clients get model responses that mismatch expected schema, causing retries and further load.

raj: confirmed. the fallback policy is set to pick the most-cost-effective variant per-region; it doesn't pin variants per-request when routing across regions. combined with the aggressive healthcheck backoff (30s) we get flapping.

sam-sre: mitigation plan: 1) pause cross-region fallback policy 2) pin model-variant for in-flight sessions 3) increase healthcheck hysteresis 4) notify support + customers. doing step 1 now.

deploy-bot: Received config change request from sam-sre. Applying: set policy.smart_routing.cross_region_fallback = false (temp).
deploy-bot: change applied at 2026-03-15T12:06:14Z, rollout id cfg-8231, scope: global, ttl: 15m.

eng-prod: I also recommend pinning model variant behavior: set session affinity for model_variant until session end. will open a quick patch.

olivia: customer-impact quick assessment: ~0.8% of requests in last 10m saw 5xxs, a small group of enterprise customers reported degraded outputs (schema mismatch), no data exfiltration. support triage started.

customer-support: posting a banner to the status page and contacting the 3 affected customers with elevated tickets.

raj: rolling an emergency config to set healthcheck.debounce = 90s and healthcheck.fail_threshold = 5 for region probes. doing a dry-run in prod control plane.

deploy-bot: patch queued: healthcheck.debounce -> 90s, fail_threshold -> 5, rollout id cfg-8232, started 2026-03-15T12:08:03Z.

sam-sre: temporarily pinning model-variant for existing sessions to the variant they started with to reduce mid-session drift. making the change at the gateway layer.

leo: small note — pinning reduces flexibility but prevents churn. we'll revert after stabilization and add a canary for variant-switch during low traffic windows.

incident-bot: escalated to SEV-2 (customer impact, partial degradation). oncall: sam-sre; escalation to eng-prod if not stable in 30m.

olivia: telemetry after the first 2 mins post-change: flip count dropped from ~7/min to ~0.5/min, 5xx rate down to 0.2%.

sam-sre: confirming — traffic stable on primary regions, no new customer complaints so far. leaving cross-region fallback disabled for 15m window to observe.

raj: config rollout cfg-8232 completed at 2026-03-15T12:12:40Z. healthchecks debounced, probe chatter subsided.

deploy-bot: TTL for cross_region_fallback disable will expire in 15m unless extended by sam-sre.

olivia: short-term mitigation success. next steps for postmortem: - root cause: aggressive healthcheck thresholds combined with per-region variant selection policy - action items: tie variant selection to session affinity OR have fallback use compatible variant families, add chaos tests for region health flaps, document runbook for disabling cross-region fallback - owners: raj (config + runbook), leo (variant-selection change), olivia (customer comms)

sam-sre: assigning owners and ETA 72h for code changes, config PRs first. I'll keep the thread open until the postmortem is posted.

eng-prod: quick note: we'll add a feature flag to make variant compatibility a hard requirement for cross-region fallback; patching backlog.

customer-support: status update sent to customers and status page updated: "Degradation in routing for a subset of requests; mitigation in progress."

olivia: thanks everyone. closing live mitigation as stable, moving to post-incident analysis. ping @raj for PM on postmortem. :white_check_mark:
